name: UHZ Cardiac MRI Arrhythmia Cohort 2024
description: Single-centre cardiac MRI cohort from the University Hospital Zürich Cardiology and Radiology departments: 1 248 paired late-gadolinium-enhancement (LGE) and cine short-axis stack acquisitions in 412 patients with documented atrial fibrillation, ventricular tachycardia, or non-arrhythmogenic structural heart disease. Each acquisition includes pixel-level scar segmentations and structured ECG-derived arrhythmia labels reviewed by two cardiologists. The cohort is held PRIVATE: byte-level access is reserved for collaborating institutions named in the original IRB approval; shared evaluation is possible on the OCI platform via in-place model execution against the cohort without participant images leaving UHZ infrastructure.

rai:dataCollection: Prospective single-centre enrolment between January 2018 and December 2023. All patients referred for cardiac MRI workup of suspected arrhythmogenic substrate at UHZ were screened; 412 met inclusion criteria (signed broad consent, no prior cardiac surgery, complete cine + LGE stack, ECG-confirmed arrhythmia status). Imaging acquired on three Siemens 1.5T and 3T scanners under a uniform departmental protocol.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Two consultant cardiologists with EACVI Level 3 CMR certification independently reviewed each case, segmenting LV scar on the LGE stack using cvi42 (Circle CVI). Disagreements (Dice <0.75) were adjudicated by a third reader. Arrhythmia labels were assigned from the patient's adjudicated 12-lead ECG and Holter recordings within ±30 days of the MRI.
rai:annotatorDemographics: Three EACVI Level 3 CMR consultants at UHZ, ages 38-55, mixed clinical and academic practice.
rai:dataBiases: Single tertiary referral centre — population enriched for moderate-to-severe disease; primary-care presentations under-represented. Geographic skew: ≈92% Swiss residents. Sex distribution: 64% male, 36% female. Scanner mix is dominated by one Siemens Aera 1.5T (≈70% of scans).
rai:dataLimitations: No 4D-flow or T1-mapping. LGE acquired on a single inversion-time per study; partial-volume effects not modelled in the masks. Holter follow-up was not uniformly available for asymptomatic patients. Race / skin-tone metadata is not captured (Swiss data-protection guidance).
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Direct identifiers removed (DICOM Safe Harbor profile + custom UHZ pseudonymisation). Date metadata is shifted by per-patient random offset. Original DICOM private tags scrubbed. Re-identification risk assessed Low by UHZ Data Protection Office given the geographic and demographic distribution.
rai:dataUseCases: Disease-specific research on arrhythmogenic substrate identification; scar-burden quantification benchmarks; in-place model evaluation via OCI Platform without participant images leaving UHZ infrastructure.
rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Maintained on UHZ secure storage. Quarterly re-adjudication of edge cases by the lead cardiologist. Annual amendment to the IRB approval; access to byte-level data terminates on 2031-03-21 unless renewed.
bio:dataAcquisitionProtocol: Cine bSSFP short-axis stack (10-12 slices, 25 phases, 8 mm slice thickness, 2 mm gap). LGE acquired 10-15 minutes post 0.15 mmol/kg gadobutrol (Gadovist) bolus, 2D segmented inversion-recovery, slice-matched to cine. ECG-gated breath-hold acquisitions; in-plane resolution 1.5×1.5 mm. Three Siemens scanners (Aera 1.5T, Sola 1.5T, Vida 3T).
bio:consentNotes: Broad informed consent for research re-use captured at admission per UHZ standard form (rev. 2017-09). Re-contact for amendment is in place via UHZ research office; opt-out is honoured at any time. Bytes never leave UHZ-controlled storage; sharing is mediated by OCI Platform's in-place evaluation.
